description: List the indexes production would refuse the app's queries for, from the queries run so far: each with the entry to add to its database's index file (firestore.indexes.json, under indexes or fieldOverrides), the first query that needed it (fields and operators, no values), how many did and when. database narrows it to one database and includeDeclared adds the entries the file already declares; saving the file puts an entry in force at once.

includeDeclared.description: Also list the indexes a saved file declares now; default only the missing ones

name: firestore_missing_indexes
